name: spellclash
title: spell clash
blurb: enter two atproto handles and each becomes an elemental spellcaster — fire, storm, tide, or stone, with a signature spell and real HP, pulled from their real public profile (tweet frequency decides how hard they hit). a turn-based magic battle drains HP until someone's out. today's theme-box idea: "account vs. account, enter two accounts and see who wins."
